name: AVA: Atomic Visual Actions Benchmark
description: A video dataset introduced by Google Research that densely annotates atomic visual actions in space and time. Contains 430 15-minute movie segments densely annotated at 1 Hz intervals, yielding over 1.6 million action labels across 80 atomic action classes (e.g. pose actions, person-person interactions, and person-object interactions). Provides person bounding boxes and multi-label action annotations to evaluate spatio-temporal action localization.
